docs.title: 4.4 Virtual Private Database (Row-Level Security)
docs.text:
Apply after schema creation — ensures data filtering at DB level:

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION QD_KYC_SECURITY.REPORT_POLICY(
  schema_name VARCHAR2, table_name VARCHAR2
) RETURN VARCHAR2 AS
  v_role    VARCHAR2(30) := SYS_CONTEXT('APEX$SESSION','APP_KYC_ROLE');
  v_uid     VARCHAR2(20) := SYS_CONTEXT('APEX$SESSION','APP_USER_ID');
BEGIN
  RETURN CASE v_role
    WHEN 'ADMIN'       THEN '1=1'
    WHEN 'APPROVER_L2' THEN '1=1'
    WHEN 'APPROVER_L1' THEN 'wf_level >= 1'
    WHEN 'CONTRIBUTOR' THEN
      'contributor_user_id = ' || v_uid ||
      ' OR report_id IN (SELECT report_id FROM QD_KYC_WF_COMMENTS ' ||
      'WHERE comment_type = ''RFI_REQUEST'')'
    ELSE '1=0'
  END;
END;

EXEC DBMS_RLS.ADD_POLICY('QD_KYC','QD_KYC_REPORT','KYC_REPORT_POLICY',
  'QD_KYC_SECURITY','REPORT_POLICY','SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE');

docs.title: 5.3 Page 13 — L1 Approval Queue
docs.text:
Property Value Page Title KYC Approval Queue — Level 1 Authorization IS_APPROVER_L1 Source QD_KYC_V_APPROVAL_QUEUE_L1 (view joining report + user + intake)

View definition: 

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW QD_KYC_V_APPROVAL_QUEUE_L1 AS
SELECT
  r.report_id, r.report_ref, r.kyc_type, r.risk_level,
  r.report_status, r.submitted_date,
  ROUND(SYSDATE - r.submitted_date) AS days_pending,
  u.full_name AS contributor_name,
  e.entity_name,
  CASE r.kyc_type
    WHEN 'SIMPLIFIED' THEN 5 WHEN 'ENHANCED' THEN 20 ELSE 10
  END AS sla_days,
  CASE
    WHEN ROUND(SYSDATE - r.submitted_date) > CASE r.kyc_type
      WHEN 'SIMPLIFIED' THEN 5 WHEN 'ENHANCED' THEN 20 ELSE 10 END
    THEN 'OVERDUE' ELSE 'ON_TRACK'
  END AS sla_status
FROM QD_KYC_REPORT r
JOIN QD_KYC_USERS  u ON u.user_id = r.contributor_user_id
JOIN QD_KYC_ENTITY e ON e.entity_id = r.entity_id
WHERE r.report_status IN ('SUBMITTED','RFI_L1')
AND   r.wf_level = 1;

Row Highlight Rules (Interactive Report → Highlight): - Name: Overdue | Condition: SLA_STATUS = 'OVERDUE' | CSS: u-hot - Name: Near SLA | Condition: DAYS_PENDING > SLA_DAYS - 2 | CSS: u-warning

Approval Action Process: 

-- Called from modal dialog submit
DECLARE
  v_action VARCHAR2(20) := :P13_ACTION;  -- APPROVE / RFI / REJECT
BEGIN
  -- Write to process log (immutable)
  INSERT INTO QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG (report_id, action_type, from_status, to_status, action_user_id, comments)
  VALUES (:P13_REPORT_ID, v_action,
          (SELECT report_status FROM QD_KYC_REPORT WHERE report_id = :P13_REPORT_ID),
          CASE v_action WHEN 'APPROVE' THEN 'APPROVED_L1'
                        WHEN 'RFI' THEN 'RFI_L1' ELSE 'REJECTED' END,
          :APP_USER_ID, :P13_COMMENT);

  -- Update report status
  UPDATE QD_KYC_REPORT SET
    report_status = CASE v_action WHEN 'APPROVE' THEN 'APPROVED_L1'
                                  WHEN 'RFI' THEN 'RFI_L1' ELSE 'REJECTED' END,
    l1_approval_date = CASE v_action WHEN 'APPROVE' THEN SYSTIMESTAMP END,
    wf_level = CASE v_action WHEN 'APPROVE' THEN 2 ELSE wf_level END
  WHERE report_id = :P13_REPORT_ID;

  -- Route by outcome
  CASE v_action
    WHEN 'APPROVE' THEN
      IF (SELECT risk_level FROM QD_KYC_REPORT WHERE report_id = :P13_REPORT_ID) = 'LOW' THEN
        QD_KYC_WORKFLOW.COMPLETE_FINAL(:P13_REPORT_ID);
      ELSE
        QD_KYC_NOTIFICATIONS.SEND_TO_ACTIVE_APPROVER('APPROVAL_REQUIRED_L2', :P13_REPORT_ID, 'APPROVER_L2');
      END IF;
    WHEN 'RFI' THEN
      INSERT INTO QD_KYC_WF_COMMENTS (report_id, comment_text, comment_type, posted_by_user_id, wf_status_at_time)
      VALUES (:P13_REPORT_ID, :P13_COMMENT, 'RFI_REQUEST', :APP_USER_ID, 'RFI_L1');
      QD_KYC_NOTIFICATIONS.SEND('RFI_ISSUED',
        (SELECT contributor_user_id FROM QD_KYC_REPORT WHERE report_id = :P13_REPORT_ID),
        :P13_REPORT_ID);
    WHEN 'REJECT' THEN
      QD_KYC_WORKFLOW.COMPLETE_REJECTED(:P13_REPORT_ID, :P13_COMMENT);
  END CASE;
END;

docs.title: 7.1 Workflow Activities (APEX Workflow Builder)
docs.text:
Workflow Name: KYC_APPROVAL_WORKFLOW
Version: 1.0

Activities:
1. DOCS_VALIDATION
   Type: Human Task
   Potential Owner: ROLE:COMPLIANCE_TEAM
   Due Days: 2
   Outcomes: DOCS_COMPLETE | DOCS_INCOMPLETE

2. ASSIGNMENT
   Type: Script Task
   Script: QD_KYC_WORKFLOW.AUTO_ASSIGN(:INTAKE_ID)
   Outcomes: ASSIGNED

3. DUE_DILIGENCE
   Type: Human Task
   Potential Owner: ASSIGNED_USER (from workflow variable)
   Due Days: Computed from KYC type (5/10/20)
   Outcomes: SUBMITTED_FOR_APPROVAL | SAVE_DRAFT

4. RISK_GATEWAY
   Type: Exclusive Gateway
   Condition LOW:  risk_level = 'LOW'  → L1_APPROVAL
   Condition ELSE: risk_level != 'LOW' → L1_APPROVAL → L2_APPROVAL

5. L1_APPROVAL
   Type: Human Task
   Potential Owner: QD_KYC_WORKFLOW.GET_ACTIVE_APPROVER('APPROVER_L1')
   Due Days: 3
   Outcomes: APPROVED_L1 | RFI_L1 | REJECTED_L1
   On RFI: loop back to DUE_DILIGENCE

6. L2_APPROVAL
   Type: Human Task
   Potential Owner: QD_KYC_WORKFLOW.GET_ACTIVE_APPROVER('APPROVER_L2')
   Due Days: 3
   Outcomes: APPROVED_FINAL | RFI_L2 | REJECTED_L2 | SAR_FLAGGED

7. FINAL_COMPLETE
   Type: Script Task
   Script: QD_KYC_WORKFLOW.COMPLETE_FINAL(:REPORT_ID)

8. SAR_REVIEW (conditional branch)
   Type: Human Task — MLRO only
   Outcomes: SAR_FILED | SAR_DISMISSED
   On DISMISSED: return to L2_APPROVAL

docs.title: 8. Nightly Monitoring Job
docs.text:
-- Full nightly job covering monitoring, SLA alerts, and Fusion sync
BEGIN
  DBMS_SCHEDULER.CREATE_JOB(
    job_name        => 'QD_KYC_NIGHTLY_JOB',
    job_type        => 'PLSQL_BLOCK',
    job_action      => Q'[
      DECLARE
        CURSOR c_review_due IS
          SELECT report_id, contributor_user_id
          FROM   QD_KYC_REPORT
          WHERE  next_review_date BETWEEN SYSDATE AND SYSDATE + 60
          AND    report_status = 'APPROVED';

        CURSOR c_overdue IS
          SELECT report_id, contributor_user_id
          FROM   QD_KYC_REPORT
          WHERE  next_review_date < SYSDATE
          AND    report_status = 'APPROVED';

        CURSOR c_sla_breach IS
          SELECT r.report_id
          FROM   QD_KYC_REPORT r
          WHERE  r.report_status NOT IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED','DRAFT')
          AND    r.submitted_date IS NOT NULL
          AND    SYSDATE - r.submitted_date >
                 CASE r.kyc_type WHEN 'SIMPLIFIED' THEN 5
                                 WHEN 'ENHANCED' THEN 20 ELSE 10 END;
      BEGIN
        FOR r IN c_review_due LOOP
          QD_KYC_NOTIFICATIONS.SEND('REVIEW_DUE_SOON', r.contributor_user_id, r.report_id);
        END LOOP;
        FOR r IN c_overdue LOOP
          QD_KYC_NOTIFICATIONS.SEND('REVIEW_OVERDUE', r.contributor_user_id, r.report_id);
        END LOOP;
        FOR r IN c_sla_breach LOOP
          QD_KYC_NOTIFICATIONS.SEND_ADMIN_ALERT('SLA breach on report_id=' || r.report_id);
        END LOOP;
        QD_KYC_FUSION_SYNC.SYNC_ALL_EMPLOYEES;
        APEX_MAIL.PUSH_QUEUE;
      END;]',
    start_date      => TRUNC(SYSDATE+1) + 6/24,
    repeat_interval => 'FREQ=DAILY;BYHOUR=6;BYMINUTE=0',
    enabled         => TRUE
  );
END;

docs.title: V5 — Oracle APEX 24 on ATP — Technical Specification
docs.text:
Prerequisites

  • Oracle APEX 24.2 or later
  • Oracle Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP) — Oracle Database 23ai
  • Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud (REST API access)
  • OCI IAM Domain configured for SSO
  • OCI Vault for credential storage
  • OCI Object Storage bucket for documents

docs.title: Oracle APEX 24 Developer Guide
docs.text: Document Type: Technical Specification — Developer Reference Audience: Oracle APEX Developers, DBAs, Integration Architects Platform: Oracle APEX 24.2 | Oracle Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP) — Database 23ai | Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud Schema: QD_KYC Authentication: OCI IAM SSO (Fusion credentials)

docs.title: 1. Document Header
docs.text: Attribute V4 (Previous) V5 (This Document) APEX Version 23.2 24.2 (latest stable) Oracle Database 19c / 21c on-premises 23ai — Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP) Identity Provider Oracle IDCS OCI IAM Domain Workflow Engine Native APEX Workflow Builder (23.2) Native APEX Workflow Builder (24.2) — enhanced task management and delegation APIs Document Storage BLOB columns / QDocs hybrid OCI Object Storage via DBMS_CLOUD Secret Storage APEX Web Credentials (plain store) OCI Vault (secret versioning, rotation) ORDS Separately installed and configured Pre-installed on ATP — no setup required Data Guard / HA Manual RAC / Data Guard configuration Autonomous Data Guard — included, zero config

docs.title: 2.1 Prerequisites
docs.text: Component Version Notes Oracle APEX 24.2 minimum Universal Theme required; pre-installed on ATP Oracle Autonomous Transaction Processing 23ai Serverless or dedicated — either supported Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) Pre-installed on ATP No manual installation; exposed via ATP HTTPS endpoint OCI IAM Domain Current Replaces IDCS; tenant-level identity domain OCI Object Storage — Bucket per environment (dev / uat / prod) OCI Vault — Stores Fusion HCM API credentials as secrets Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud (any current release) REST APIs must be reachable from ATP egress SQL Developer Web Included with ATP Accessible from OCI Console — no client install required

docs.title: 2.2 ATP Provisioning Steps
docs.text:
1. In OCI Console navigate to Oracle Database → Autonomous Transaction Processing → Create Autonomous Database.
  2. Choose Transaction Processing workload type.
  3. Set Database name to QDKYCATP and Display name to QD KYC ATP.
  4. Select Serverless (recommended) or Dedicated infrastructure.
  5. Set ADMIN password following OCI complexity rules (min 12 chars, upper/lower/digit/special).
  6. Enable Autonomous Data Guard (standby in same or remote region).
  7. Download the Instance Wallet (mTLS): OCI Console → Database Connection → Download Wallet. Store securely; required for all JDBC/SQL*Net client connections.
  8. Note the ATP HTTPS endpoint for ORDS/APEX access: https://<atp-hostname>/ords/.

ATP storage note: There are no tablespaces to create or manage. ATP provisions storage automatically and expands on demand. Do not specify DEFAULT TABLESPACE or QUOTA in DDL — ATP ignores tablespace clauses and manages all allocation internally.

docs.title: 2.3 APEX Workspace Setup on ATP
docs.text:
APEX 24.2 is pre-installed on ATP. No separate APEX installation step is required.

  1. Access APEX Administration: https://<atp-hostname>/ords/apex → Internal workspace → admin user (ADMIN password set during ATP provisioning).
  2. Create workspace QD_KYC mapped to schema QD_KYC.
  3. Upload the APEX application export file or develop directly from the workspace.

docs.title: 3.1 Schema Creation on ATP
docs.text:
On ATP, schema creation is simplified. No tablespace specification, no quota setting.

-- Connect as ADMIN user (ATP)
CREATE USER qd_kyc IDENTIFIED BY "<strong-password>";

GRANT CREATE SESSION, CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, CREATE SEQUENCE,
      CREATE TRIGGER, CREATE PROCEDURE, CREATE TYPE,
      CREATE SYNONYM TO qd_kyc;

-- Required for DBMS_CLOUD (OCI Object Storage integration)
EXEC DBMS_CLOUD_ADMIN.ENABLE_PRINCIPAL_PROPAGATION(schema_name => 'QD_KYC');

-- Grant DBMS_CLOUD execution privilege
GRANT EXECUTE ON DBMS_CLOUD TO qd_kyc;

-- Grant APEX workspace access
BEGIN
  APEX_INSTANCE_ADMIN.ADD_WORKSPACE(
    p_workspace_id   => NULL,
    p_workspace      => 'QD_KYC',
    p_primary_schema => 'QD_KYC'
  );
END;
/

docs.title: 3.2 Core Table Structure
docs.text:
ATP manages storage allocation automatically. All V4 table structures carry forward unchanged. Define tables without tablespace clauses; ATP auto-assigns storage and applies auto-indexing for frequently queried columns.

All tables follow these standards (unchanged from V4):

  • Primary key: NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY
  • Audit columns on every table: created_by, created_date, updated_by, updated_date, row_version
  • created_by defaults to SYS_CONTEXT('APEX$SESSION','APP_USER')
  • created_date defaults to SYSTIMESTAMP
  • Enum-style columns enforced via CHECK constraints
Table Purpose Key FK Relationships QD_KYC_USERS Fusion employee cache + KYC roles deputy_user_id → QD_KYC_USERS QD_KYC_DEPARTMENTS Fusion org cache manager_user_id → QD_KYC_USERS QD_KYC_INTAKE Digital intake submissions requestor_user_id, department_id, assigned_user_id QD_KYC_ENTITY Counterparty records with versioning superseded_by_id → QD_KYC_ENTITY QD_KYC_UBO UBO/participant records entity_id → QD_KYC_ENTITY QD_KYC_REPORT KYC reports intake_id, entity_id, contributor_user_id QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG Immutable compliance audit trail report_id, intake_id, action_user_id QD_KYC_WF_COMMENTS Workflow comments/RFI thread report_id, intake_id, posted_by_user_id QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS File metadata (OCI Object Storage) report_id, intake_id, entity_id QD_KYC_REF_* Reference/lookup tables None — standalone

V5 change — QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS: The file_blob column is removed. Documents are stored in OCI Object Storage. The table retains metadata columns: object_storage_uri, bucket_name, object_name, mime_type, file_size_bytes. The DBMS_CLOUD package handles upload and download.

docs.title: 3.3 Audit Trigger Template (unchanged from V4)
docs.text:
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER QD_KYC_<TABLE>_AUR
  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON QD_KYC_<TABLE>
  FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  IF INSERTING THEN
    :NEW.created_by   := NVL(SYS_CONTEXT('APEX$SESSION','APP_USER'), USER);
    :NEW.created_date := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    :NEW.row_version  := 1;
  ELSIF UPDATING THEN
    :NEW.updated_by   := NVL(SYS_CONTEXT('APEX$SESSION','APP_USER'), USER);
    :NEW.updated_date := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    :NEW.row_version  := NVL(:OLD.row_version, 0) + 1;
  END IF;
END;
/

docs.title: 3.4 Immutable Process Log Protection (unchanged from V4)
docs.text:
-- CRITICAL: This trigger must never be removed or disabled
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG_PROTECT
  BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG
BEGIN
  RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
    'QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG is an immutable audit table. '
    || 'UPDATE and DELETE operations are not permitted.');
END;
/

docs.title: 3.5 Reference Number Triggers (unchanged from V4)
docs.text:
-- Intake reference: INTAKE-YYYY-000001
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER QD_KYC_INTAKE_BIR
  BEFORE INSERT ON QD_KYC_INTAKE FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  :NEW.intake_ref := 'INTAKE-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')
                     || '-' || LPAD(QD_KYC_INTAKE_SEQ.NEXTVAL,6,'0');
END;
/

-- Entity reference: ENT-YYYY-000001 + chronic_id seeding
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER QD_KYC_ENTITY_BIR
  BEFORE INSERT ON QD_KYC_ENTITY FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  :NEW.entity_ref := 'ENT-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')
                     || '-' || LPAD(QD_KYC_ENTITY_SEQ.NEXTVAL,6,'0');
  IF :NEW.chronic_id IS NULL THEN
    :NEW.chronic_id := QD_KYC_ENTITY_SEQ.CURRVAL;
  END IF;
END;
/

-- KYC reference: KYC-YYYY-000001 + derived fields
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER QD_KYC_REPORT_BIR
  BEFORE INSERT ON QD_KYC_REPORT FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  :NEW.report_ref := 'KYC-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')
                     || '-' || LPAD(QD_KYC_REPORT_SEQ.NEXTVAL,6,'0');
  :NEW.due_diligence_type := CASE :NEW.kyc_type
    WHEN 'SIMPLIFIED' THEN 'Simplified Due Diligence (SDD)'
    WHEN 'ENHANCED'   THEN 'Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)'
    ELSE 'Standard Due Diligence' END;
  :NEW.review_cycle_months := CASE :NEW.risk_level
    WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 12 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 24 ELSE 36 END;
  :NEW.next_review_date := ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, :NEW.review_cycle_months);
END;
/

docs.title: 3.6 ATP Auto-Management Notes
docs.text:
• Auto-indexing: ATP monitors query workloads and creates additional indexes automatically. The performance indexes defined in Section 10 are still required as the baseline; ATP may supplement them. Do not drop ATP-created auto-indexes.
  • Auto-statistics: DBMS_STATS jobs run automatically. Manual statistics gathering is not required in normal operation.
  • Connection from PL/SQL to OCI services: Uses DBMS_CLOUD package which is pre-installed on ATP. No UTL_HTTP ACL configuration is needed for OCI Object Storage or OCI Vault REST endpoints accessed via DBMS_CLOUD.

docs.title: 4.1 ATP Wallet (mTLS Connection)
docs.text: All external clients (SQL Developer, CI/CD pipelines, JDBC datasources) connect to ATP using the mTLS wallet downloaded in Section 2.2. Configure sqlnet.ora and tnsnames.ora from the wallet contents. APEX and ORDS running on the same ATP instance connect internally and do not require the wallet.

docs.title: 4.2 OCI Vault — Fusion HCM API Credentials
docs.text:
OCI Vault replaces APEX Web Credentials as the storage mechanism for the Fusion HCM integration user credentials. This provides versioned secrets with audit logging and IAM-controlled access.

Vault and secret setup (OCI Console):

  1. Create a Vault in the target compartment: Security → Vault → Create Vault (type: Default).
  2. Create a Master Encryption Key (AES-256).
  3. Create two secrets:
Secret Name Contents QD-KYC-FUSION-USERNAME Fusion integration service account username QD-KYC-FUSION-PASSWORD Fusion integration service account password
  1. Grant the ATP instance dynamic group read access to these secrets via IAM policy:
Allow dynamic-group <atp-dynamic-group> to read secret-bundles
  in compartment <compartment-name>
  where target.vault.id = '<vault-ocid>'

PL/SQL retrieval of secrets at runtime:

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION QD_KYC_VAULT.GET_SECRET(
  p_secret_ocid IN VARCHAR2
) RETURN VARCHAR2 AS
  v_response  CLOB;
  v_secret    VARCHAR2(4000);
BEGIN
  -- DBMS_CLOUD.GET_OBJECT retrieves the secret bundle via OCI Vault REST API
  v_response := DBMS_CLOUD.GET_OBJECT(
    credential_name => 'OCI$RESOURCE_PRINCIPAL',
    object_uri      => 'https://secrets.vaults.<region>.oci.oraclecloud.com/20190301/secretbundles/'
                       || p_secret_ocid || '?stage=CURRENT'
  );
  -- Extract secretBundleContent.content (base64 encoded)
  v_secret := UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_VARCHAR2(
    UTL_ENCODE.BASE64_DECODE(
      UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW(
        JSON_VALUE(v_response, '$.secretBundleContent.content')
      )
    )
  );
  RETURN v_secret;
END;
/

Secrets are fetched at call time and never cached in session state or logged. Rotate secrets in OCI Vault without any application code change.

docs.title: 4.3 OCI Object Storage — Document Bucket Configuration
docs.text:
1. In OCI Console: Storage → Object Storage → Create Bucket.
  2. Create one bucket per environment:
Environment Bucket Name Visibility Development qd-kyc-docs-dev Private UAT qd-kyc-docs-uat Private Production qd-kyc-docs-prod Private
  1. Enable Object Versioning on production bucket.
  2. Apply Lifecycle Policy: move objects to Infrequent Access storage after 90 days.
  3. Grant the ATP instance dynamic group access:
Allow dynamic-group <atp-dynamic-group> to manage objects
  in compartment <compartment-name>
  where target.bucket.name = 'qd-kyc-docs-prod'
  1. In ATP, create a credential referencing the Resource Principal (no API key required when ATP has dynamic group membership):
-- On ATP: Resource Principal credential is pre-created as OCI$RESOURCE_PRINCIPAL
-- Verify it exists:
SELECT credential_name, enabled
FROM   all_credentials
WHERE  credential_name = 'OCI$RESOURCE_PRINCIPAL';

docs.title: 4.4 OCI IAM Domain Configuration
docs.text:
OCI IAM replaces Oracle IDCS. The configuration is performed in the OCI IAM Domain console, not the legacy IDCS console.

Steps:

  1. In OCI Console: Identity & Security → Domains → [your domain].
  2. Navigate to Applications → Add Application → Confidential Application.
  3. Set Name to QD-KYC-APEX.
  4. Under OAuth Configuration:
  5. Grant types: Authorization Code, Client Credentials
  6. Redirect URL: https://<atp-hostname>/ords/apex_authentication.callback
  7. Post-logout redirect: https://<atp-hostname>/ords/f?p=100
  8. Scopes: openid profile email
  9. Note the Client ID and generate a Client Secret (store in OCI Vault as QD-KYC-IAM-CLIENT-SECRET).
  10. Token endpoint (V5 format): 
    https://<domain-prefix>.identity.oraclecloud.com/oauth2/v1/token
    This replaces the V4 endpoint format https://idcs-<tenancy>.identity.oraclecloud.com/oauth2/v1/token.

docs.title: 5.1 REST API Connectivity — OCI Vault Credential Retrieval
docs.text:
In V5, credentials are fetched from OCI Vault at runtime rather than read from the APEX Web Credential store.

-- Package specification: QD_KYC_FUSION_SYNC (updated for V5)
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE QD_KYC_FUSION_SYNC AS
  c_fusion_base_url       CONSTANT VARCHAR2(200) := 'https://<fusion-host>';
  c_fusion_user_secret    CONSTANT VARCHAR2(200) := '<ocid1.vaultsecret...username>';
  c_fusion_pwd_secret     CONSTANT VARCHAR2(200) := '<ocid1.vaultsecret...password>';

  PROCEDURE sync_all_employees;
  PROCEDURE sync_employee(p_person_id IN VARCHAR2);
  PROCEDURE sync_org_structure;
  FUNCTION  get_kyc_role(p_job_code IN VARCHAR2, p_dept_id IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2;

PRIVATE:
  FUNCTION get_credential RETURN apex_t_varchar2;  -- returns (username, password)
END;
/

-- Credential retrieval and REST call
FUNCTION QD_KYC_FUSION_SYNC.CALL_FUSION_API(p_path IN VARCHAR2) RETURN CLOB AS
  v_user      VARCHAR2(200) := QD_KYC_VAULT.GET_SECRET(c_fusion_user_secret);
  v_pass      VARCHAR2(200) := QD_KYC_VAULT.GET_SECRET(c_fusion_pwd_secret);
  v_response  CLOB;
BEGIN
  -- Build Basic Auth header at runtime from Vault secrets
  v_response := APEX_WEB_SERVICE.MAKE_REST_REQUEST(
    p_url         => c_fusion_base_url || p_path,
    p_http_method => 'GET',
    p_username    => v_user,
    p_password    => v_pass
  );
  RETURN v_response;
END;

FUNCTION get_kyc_role(p_job_code IN VARCHAR2, p_dept_id IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 AS
BEGIN
  RETURN CASE
    WHEN p_job_code LIKE '%RISK_COMPLIANCE_HEAD%'    THEN 'APPROVER_L2'
    WHEN p_job_code LIKE '%RISK_COMPLIANCE_MGR%'     THEN 'APPROVER_L1'
    WHEN p_job_code LIKE '%RISK_COMPLIANCE_SR%'      THEN 'CONTRIBUTOR'
    WHEN p_job_code LIKE '%RISK_COMPLIANCE%'         THEN 'CONTRIBUTOR'
    WHEN p_job_code LIKE '%IT_ADMIN%'                THEN 'ADMIN'
    ELSE 'REQUESTOR'
  END;
END;

docs.title: 6.2 Authentication Scheme — OCI IAM
docs.text:
In V5, the authentication scheme type changes from "Oracle IDCS / Social Sign-In" to the native OCI IAM type available in APEX 24.2.

Type:         OCI Native Authentication (IAM)
Name:         OCI IAM SSO

Client ID:    <Client ID from OCI IAM Application — see Section 4.4>
Client Secret Credential:
              Type: OCI Native Authentication (IAM)
              -- Reference the Web Credential created below, which holds
              -- the Client Secret retrieved from OCI Vault

Token Endpoint:
  https://<domain-prefix>.identity.oraclecloud.com/oauth2/v1/token

Scope:        openid profile email

Post-Authentication Procedure: QD_KYC_AUTH.POST_LOGIN
  -- Unchanged logic from V4:
  --   1. Looks up user in QD_KYC_USERS by email from id_token claims
  --   2. If not found: calls QD_KYC_FUSION_SYNC.SYNC_EMPLOYEE to auto-provision
  --   3. Sets APP session state:
  --        APP_KYC_ROLE  := user's kyc_role
  --        APP_USER_ID   := user's user_id
  --        APP_DEPT_ID   := user's department_id
  --        APP_FULL_NAME := user's full_name
  --   4. Redirects to role-appropriate landing page

APEX Web Credential for IAM Client Secret:

Name:           OCI_IAM_CLIENT_CRED
Type:           OCI Native Authentication (IAM)
Client ID:      <same Client ID as above>
Client Secret:  <value fetched from OCI Vault secret QD-KYC-IAM-CLIENT-SECRET>

Unlike V4 where the IDCS client secret was stored directly in the APEX credential store, in V5 the client secret value is sourced from OCI Vault and entered here. Rotation requires updating the Vault secret and re-entering the value in this credential — or automate via OCI Functions + APEX REST API.

IS_CONTRIBUTOR    → :APP_KYC_ROLE IN ('CONTRIBUTOR','APPROVER_L1','APPROVER_L2','ADMIN')
IS_APPROVER_L1    → :APP_KYC_ROLE IN ('APPROVER_L1','APPROVER_L2','ADMIN')
IS_APPROVER_L2    → :APP_KYC_ROLE IN ('APPROVER_L2','ADMIN')

                    AND :P12_CONTRIBUTOR_USER_ID = :APP_USER_ID
                    AND :P12_REPORT_STATUS = 'DRAFT'

docs.title: 6.4 Virtual Private Database — Row-Level Security (unchanged from V4)
docs.text:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION QD_KYC_SECURITY.REPORT_POLICY(
  schema_name VARCHAR2, table_name VARCHAR2
) RETURN VARCHAR2 AS
  v_role    VARCHAR2(30) := SYS_CONTEXT('APEX$SESSION','APP_KYC_ROLE');
  v_uid     VARCHAR2(20) := SYS_CONTEXT('APEX$SESSION','APP_USER_ID');
BEGIN
  RETURN CASE v_role
    WHEN 'ADMIN'       THEN '1=1'
    WHEN 'APPROVER_L2' THEN '1=1'
    WHEN 'APPROVER_L1' THEN 'wf_level >= 1'
    WHEN 'CONTRIBUTOR' THEN
      'contributor_user_id = ' || v_uid ||
      ' OR report_id IN (SELECT report_id FROM QD_KYC_WF_COMMENTS ' ||
      'WHERE comment_type = ''RFI_REQUEST'')'
    ELSE '1=0'
  END;
END;
/

docs.title: 7.1 Overview — Native APEX Workflow Engine
docs.text:
APEX Workflow Builder was introduced in APEX 23.2 (V4) and is carried forward in APEX 24.2 (V5) with enhanced task management and delegation APIs. V5 uses the same declarative workflow definition approach as V4 but benefits from the improved Human Task delegation framework and the tighter ATP/OCI IAM integration.

Key differences from V4:

Aspect V4 (APEX 23.2) V5 (APEX 24.2) Workflow definition Declarative Workflow Builder Declarative Workflow Builder (same approach) Starting a workflow APEX_WORKFLOW.START_WORKFLOW(...) APEX_WORKFLOW.START_WORKFLOW(...) (unchanged) Human task delegation Basic deputy configuration Enhanced delegation API with OCI IAM group-based routing Task inbox APEX Task Manager (23.2) APEX Task Manager (24.2) — improved mobile layout Workflow state APEX workflow tables + QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG APEX workflow tables + QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG (unchanged)

QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG is retained in V5 as the compliance audit trail. It is written to at each workflow transition by Script Tasks, independent of the APEX workflow state tables.

docs.title: 7.2 Workflow Definition — KYC_APPROVAL_WORKFLOW
docs.text:
Configure in Workflow Builder: App Builder → Shared Components → Workflows → Create.

Workflow Name:    KYC_APPROVAL_WORKFLOW
Static ID:        KYC_APPROVAL_WF
Version:          2.0 (V5)

Workflow Variables:
  INTAKE_ID        NUMBER
  REPORT_ID        NUMBER
  RISK_LEVEL       VARCHAR2(10)
  ASSIGNED_USER_ID NUMBER
  KYC_TYPE         VARCHAR2(20)

docs.title: 7.3 Workflow Activities
docs.text:
All eight activities are configured declaratively in Workflow Builder. Activity names and logical flow are unchanged from V4.

Activity 1: DOCS_VALIDATION

Type:             Human Task
Static ID:        DOCS_VALIDATION
Potential Owner:  ROLE:COMPLIANCE_TEAM
Due Days:         2
Task Subject:     'Document Validation required for Intake ' || :INTAKE_ID
Outcomes:         DOCS_COMPLETE | DOCS_INCOMPLETE
On Complete:      Script Task → write QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG entry

Activity 2: ASSIGNMENT

Type:             Script Task
Static ID:        ASSIGNMENT
PL/SQL Block:
  BEGIN
    :ASSIGNED_USER_ID := QD_KYC_WORKFLOW_UTILS.AUTO_ASSIGN(:INTAKE_ID);
    UPDATE QD_KYC_INTAKE SET assigned_user_id = :ASSIGNED_USER_ID,
           status = 'ASSIGNED' WHERE intake_id = :INTAKE_ID;
    INSERT INTO QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG (intake_id, action_type, to_status, action_user_id)
    VALUES (:INTAKE_ID, 'AUTO_ASSIGN', 'ASSIGNED', :ASSIGNED_USER_ID);
  END;
Outcome:          ASSIGNED

Activity 3: DUE_DILIGENCE

Type:             Human Task
Static ID:        DUE_DILIGENCE
Potential Owner:  Workflow Variable: ASSIGNED_USER_ID
Due Days:         Expression: CASE :KYC_TYPE WHEN 'SIMPLIFIED' THEN 5
                                             WHEN 'ENHANCED' THEN 20 ELSE 10 END
Task Subject:     'KYC Due Diligence — Report ' || :REPORT_ID
Outcomes:         SUBMITTED_FOR_APPROVAL | SAVE_DRAFT

Activity 4: RISK_GATEWAY

Type:             Exclusive Gateway
Static ID:        RISK_GATEWAY
Conditions:
  LOW:  Workflow Variable RISK_LEVEL = 'LOW'  → next: L1_APPROVAL
  ELSE: Workflow Variable RISK_LEVEL != 'LOW' → next: L1_APPROVAL
        (L1 routes onward to L2 on APPROVED_L1 outcome)

Activity 5: L1_APPROVAL

Type:             Human Task
Static ID:        L1_APPROVAL
Potential Owner:  Expression: QD_KYC_WORKFLOW_UTILS.GET_ACTIVE_APPROVER('APPROVER_L1')
Due Days:         3
Task Subject:     'L1 Approval required — KYC Report ' || :REPORT_ID
Outcomes:         APPROVED_L1 | RFI_L1 | REJECTED_L1
On RFI_L1:        Loop back to DUE_DILIGENCE activity
On APPROVED_L1:   Gateway check — if RISK_LEVEL = 'LOW' → FINAL_COMPLETE
                                  else → L2_APPROVAL
On Complete:      Script Task → INSERT INTO QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG; UPDATE QD_KYC_REPORT

Activity 6: L2_APPROVAL

Type:             Human Task
Static ID:        L2_APPROVAL
Potential Owner:  Expression: QD_KYC_WORKFLOW_UTILS.GET_ACTIVE_APPROVER('APPROVER_L2')
Due Days:         3
Task Subject:     'L2 Approval required — KYC Report ' || :REPORT_ID
Outcomes:         APPROVED_FINAL | RFI_L2 | REJECTED_L2 | SAR_FLAGGED
On RFI_L2:        Loop back to DUE_DILIGENCE activity
On SAR_FLAGGED:   Route to SAR_REVIEW activity
On Complete:      Script Task → INSERT INTO QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG; UPDATE QD_KYC_REPORT

Activity 7: FINAL_COMPLETE

Type:             Script Task
Static ID:        FINAL_COMPLETE
PL/SQL Block:
  BEGIN
    QD_KYC_WORKFLOW_UTILS.COMPLETE_FINAL(:REPORT_ID);
    -- COMPLETE_FINAL: sets report_status='APPROVED', stamps final_approval_date,
    -- generates PDF via APEX_EXEC, stores in OCI Object Storage,
    -- sends KYC_COMPLETE email with document link, seals report (is_draft='N'),
    -- writes final QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG entry
  END;

Activity 8: SAR_REVIEW (conditional branch)

Type:             Human Task
Static ID:        SAR_REVIEW
Potential Owner:  ROLE:MLRO
Due Days:         5
Task Subject:     'SAR Review required — KYC Report ' || :REPORT_ID
Outcomes:         SAR_FILED | SAR_DISMISSED
On SAR_DISMISSED: Return to L2_APPROVAL (approval proceeds normally)
On SAR_FILED:     Script Task → record SAR outcome; set report_status='SAR_PROCESS';
                  notify Head of Compliance and System Administrator;
                  suspend workflow (report remains open, not rejected)

Design note: A SAR flag pauses the KYC approval — it does not close the case as rejected. The KYC report remains in SAR_PROCESS status while the SAR is handled through a separate process. Once the SAR process concludes, the compliance administrator manually returns the case to L2 approval or closes it based on the outcome of the SAR review.

docs.title: 8.1 QD_KYC_WORKFLOW_UTILS (replaces QD_KYC_WORKFLOW in V4)
docs.text:
In V5, the workflow orchestration logic moves to APEX Workflow Builder. The PL/SQL package retains utility functions called by Script Tasks and Human Task owner expressions.

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE QD_KYC_WORKFLOW_UTILS AS
  -- Called by Activity 2 (ASSIGNMENT) Script Task
  FUNCTION AUTO_ASSIGN(p_intake_id IN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER;

  -- Called by L1_APPROVAL and L2_APPROVAL owner expressions
  FUNCTION GET_ACTIVE_APPROVER(p_role IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER;
  -- Returns user_id of active, non-on-leave approver; falls back to deputy.
  -- Raises admin alert if no approver found.

  -- Called by Activity 7 (FINAL_COMPLETE) Script Task
  PROCEDURE COMPLETE_FINAL(p_report_id IN NUMBER);
  -- Sets report_status='APPROVED'; stamps final_approval_date;
  -- generates PDF; uploads to OCI Object Storage via QD_KYC_DOCS.UPLOAD_TO_OCI;
  -- sends KYC_COMPLETE notification; seals report; writes process log.

  -- Called by L1/L2 Script Task on REJECTED outcome
  PROCEDURE COMPLETE_REJECTED(p_report_id IN NUMBER, p_reason IN VARCHAR2);
  -- Called by SAR_REVIEW Script Task on SAR_FILED outcome
  PROCEDURE FLAG_SAR_PROCESS(p_report_id IN NUMBER);
END;
/

The following V4 procedures are no longer needed as standalone PL/SQL because APEX Workflow handles state transitions natively: QD_KYC_WORKFLOW.LAUNCH — replaced by APEX_WORKFLOW.START_WORKFLOW Workflow routing logic (L1→L2 escalation) — replaced by Workflow Builder gateway conditions Task creation and assignment — replaced by Human Task activity owner expressions

docs.title: 9.1 Upload Document (from APEX File Upload)
docs.text:
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE QD_KYC_DOCS AS
  PROCEDURE UPLOAD_TO_OCI(
    p_intake_id   IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_report_id   IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_entity_id   IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_file_name   IN VARCHAR2,
    p_mime_type   IN VARCHAR2,
    p_file_blob   IN BLOB
  );

  PROCEDURE SAVE_APEX_FILES(
    p_intake_id   IN NUMBER,
    p_file_names  IN VARCHAR2  -- colon-separated list from APEX file upload item
  );

  FUNCTION GET_DOWNLOAD_URL(
    p_document_id IN NUMBER,
    p_expiry_mins IN NUMBER DEFAULT 60
  ) RETURN VARCHAR2;

  PROCEDURE DELETE_DOCUMENT(p_document_id IN NUMBER);
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY QD_KYC_DOCS AS

  c_bucket_name  CONSTANT VARCHAR2(100) := 'qd-kyc-docs-prod';
  c_namespace    CONSTANT VARCHAR2(100) := '<oci-object-storage-namespace>';
  c_region       CONSTANT VARCHAR2(50)  := '<region>';  -- e.g. me-abudhabi-1

  PROCEDURE UPLOAD_TO_OCI(
    p_intake_id   IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_report_id   IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_entity_id   IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
    p_file_name   IN VARCHAR2,
    p_mime_type   IN VARCHAR2,
    p_file_blob   IN BLOB
  ) AS
    v_object_name  VARCHAR2(500);
    v_object_uri   VARCHAR2(1000);
    v_doc_id       NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    -- Object path: <year>/<intake|report>/<id>/<filename>
    v_object_name := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') || '/'
      || CASE WHEN p_intake_id  IS NOT NULL THEN 'intake/'  || p_intake_id
              WHEN p_report_id  IS NOT NULL THEN 'report/'  || p_report_id
              WHEN p_entity_id  IS NOT NULL THEN 'entity/'  || p_entity_id
         END || '/' || p_file_name;

    v_object_uri := 'https://objectstorage.' || c_region
      || '.oraclecloud.com/n/' || c_namespace
      || '/b/' || c_bucket_name || '/o/' || v_object_name;

    -- Upload via DBMS_CLOUD (pre-installed on ATP)
    DBMS_CLOUD.PUT_OBJECT(
      credential_name => 'OCI$RESOURCE_PRINCIPAL',
      object_uri      => v_object_uri,
      contents        => p_file_blob
    );

    -- Store metadata in QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS
    INSERT INTO QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS (
      intake_id, report_id, entity_id,
      file_name, mime_type,
      file_size_bytes, object_name, bucket_name, object_storage_uri
    ) VALUES (
      p_intake_id, p_report_id, p_entity_id,
      p_file_name, p_mime_type,
      DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(p_file_blob), v_object_name, c_bucket_name, v_object_uri
    ) RETURNING document_id INTO v_doc_id;
  END UPLOAD_TO_OCI;

  PROCEDURE SAVE_APEX_FILES(
    p_intake_id   IN NUMBER,
    p_file_names  IN VARCHAR2
  ) AS
    v_blob      BLOB;
    v_mime      VARCHAR2(200);
    v_fname     VARCHAR2(500);
  BEGIN
    FOR r IN (
      SELECT filename, blob_content, mime_type
      FROM   apex_application_temp_files
      WHERE  name = p_file_names
    ) LOOP
      UPLOAD_TO_OCI(
        p_intake_id => p_intake_id,
        p_file_name => r.filename,
        p_mime_type => r.mime_type,
        p_file_blob => r.blob_content
      );
    END LOOP;
  END SAVE_APEX_FILES;

  FUNCTION GET_DOWNLOAD_URL(
    p_document_id IN NUMBER,
    p_expiry_mins IN NUMBER DEFAULT 60
  ) RETURN VARCHAR2 AS
    v_uri     VARCHAR2(1000);
    v_object  VARCHAR2(500);
    v_preauthenticated_url  VARCHAR2(2000);
  BEGIN
    SELECT object_storage_uri, object_name
    INTO   v_uri, v_object
    FROM   QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS
    WHERE  document_id = p_document_id;

    -- Generate a pre-authenticated request URL via OCI Object Storage API
    v_preauthenticated_url := DBMS_CLOUD.GET_OBJECT(
      credential_name => 'OCI$RESOURCE_PRINCIPAL',
      object_uri      => 'https://objectstorage.' || c_region
        || '.oraclecloud.com/n/' || c_namespace
        || '/b/' || c_bucket_name
        || '/p/?accessType=ObjectRead&name=' || UTL_URL.ESCAPE(v_object)
        || '&timeExpires=' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP + p_expiry_mins/1440,
                               'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
    );
    RETURN v_preauthenticated_url;
  END GET_DOWNLOAD_URL;

END QD_KYC_DOCS;
/

docs.title: 10.3 APEX Native Workflow
docs.text:
□ Workflow KYC_APPROVAL_WF is active and version 2.0 in Shared Components

□ APEX Task Manager shows DOCS_VALIDATION task assigned to COMPLIANCE_TEAM role

docs.title: V6 — APEX 26 AI on ATP Spec
V6 — Oracle APEX 26 AI on ATP — Technical Specification
docs.text:
Prerequisites

  • Oracle APEX 26 or later
  • Oracle Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP) — Oracle Database 23ai
  • Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud (REST API access)
  • OCI IAM Domain configured for SSO
  • OCI Vault for credential storage
  • OCI Object Storage bucket for documents
  • OCI Generative AI Service enabled in tenancy
  • OCI AI Document Understanding enabled in tenancy

docs.title: Oracle APEX 26 AI — KYC Management System
docs.text: Document Type: Technical Specification — Developer Reference Audience: Oracle APEX Developers, DBAs, AI/ML Integration Architects Platform: Oracle APEX 26 | Oracle Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP) — Database 23ai | OCI Generative AI Service | OCI AI Document Understanding Schema: QD_KYC Authentication: OCI IAM SSO (Fusion credentials)

docs.title: 1. Document Header
docs.text:
Component V5 (APEX 24) V6 (APEX 26 AI) APEX Version 24.2 26.x Oracle Database ATP 23ai ATP 23ai (AI Vector Search enabled) Identity Provider OCI IAM Domain OCI IAM Domain (unchanged) Workflow Engine Native APEX Workflow Builder Native APEX Workflow Builder (unchanged) Document Storage OCI Object Storage via DBMS_CLOUD OCI Object Storage + AI Document Understanding classification Secret Storage OCI Vault OCI Vault (unchanged) Duplicate Detection Manual name search AI Vector Search — VECTOR_DISTANCE cosine similarity Document Classification Manual officer selection OCI AI Document Understanding — automated classification with confidence score Risk Scoring Officer manual entry OCI Generative AI suggestion — officer accepts or overrides Conclusion Authoring Officer free-text OCI Generative AI draft — officer edits and finalises Natural Language Query Not supported Select AI — SELECT AI NARRATE on approved views AI Assistant Not supported APEX AI Assistant (APEX 26 built-in) — reference data only AI Audit Not applicable QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT — immutable record of every AI interaction

All V5 components (APEX Workflow, OCI Object Storage, OCI IAM, APEX Web Credentials, Fusion HCM integration) carry forward unchanged. This document covers only the AI-specific additions.

docs.title: 2. Prerequisites and OCI AI Services Setup
2.1 All V5 Prerequisites
docs.text: Refer to V5 specification section 2 for ATP provisioning, ORDS configuration, OCI IAM SSO setup, OCI Vault, and OCI Object Storage bucket configuration. These are unchanged in V6.

docs.title: 2.2 OCI Generative AI Service
docs.text:
1. In OCI Console navigate to AI Services → Generative AI.
  2. Confirm the service is available in your tenancy region. As of the publication date, OCI Generative AI is available in us-chicago-1, us-ashburn-1, eu-frankfurt-1, and ap-osaka-1. If the KYC tenancy home region is not listed, enable a remote region subscription under OCI Console → Administration → Region Management.
  3. No additional provisioning is required; the service is consumption-based.
  4. Note the inference endpoint format — used in all PL/SQL REST calls:
https://inference.generativeai.{region}.oci.oraclecloud.com

Example for Chicago:

https://inference.generativeai.us-chicago-1.oci.oraclecloud.com

docs.title: 2.3 OCI AI Document Understanding
docs.text:
1. In OCI Console navigate to AI Services → Document Understanding.
  2. Enable the service for the tenancy compartment.
  3. Create a Project: AI Services → Document Understanding → Projects → Create Project. Name: KYC_DOC_PROJECT. Note the project OCID.
  4. The service uses inline document submission (base64) — no Object Storage pre-staging required for classification calls.

docs.title: 2.4 IAM Policies
docs.text:
Add the following policies to the KYC dynamic group (QD_KYC_ATP_DG) that covers the ATP database instance:

# Allow ATP to call OCI Generative AI
allow dynamic-group QD_KYC_ATP_DG to use generative-ai-family
  in compartment id <KYC_COMPARTMENT_OCID>

# Allow ATP to call OCI AI Document Understanding
allow dynamic-group QD_KYC_ATP_DG to use ai-document-family
  in compartment id <KYC_COMPARTMENT_OCID>

Verify the dynamic group rule matches the ATP OCID:

matching_rule = "resource.id = '<ATP_OCID>'"

docs.title: 2.5 Database Credential for OCI Gen AI
docs.text:
Create an OCI Vault-backed credential in the ATP schema:

BEGIN
  DBMS_CLOUD.CREATE_CREDENTIAL(
    credential_name => 'OCI_GENAI_CRED',
    user_ocid       => '<USER_OR_INSTANCE_PRINCIPAL_OCID>',
    tenancy_ocid    => '<TENANCY_OCID>',
    private_key     => '<PEM_PRIVATE_KEY>',
    fingerprint     => '<API_KEY_FINGERPRINT>'
  );
END;
/

For production, prefer Instance Principal authentication via the ATP dynamic group — omit user_ocid, private_key, and fingerprint, and set auth_type => 'instance_principal' where supported by the APEX_WEB_SERVICE call.

docs.title: 3. Database Schema Changes
docs.text: All V5 tables remain unchanged. The following DDL adds AI-specific columns and creates the new AI audit table.

docs.title: 3.1 QD_KYC_ENTITY — Vector Embedding Columns
docs.text:
ALTER TABLE QD_KYC_ENTITY ADD (
  name_embedding   VECTOR(1536, FLOAT32),
  embedding_date   DATE
);

COMMENT ON COLUMN QD_KYC_ENTITY.name_embedding  IS 'OCI Gen AI 1536-dim embedding of normalised entity name';
COMMENT ON COLUMN QD_KYC_ENTITY.embedding_date  IS 'Date embedding was last generated or refreshed';

docs.title: 3.2 QD_KYC_REPORT — AI Risk and Conclusion Columns
docs.text:
ALTER TABLE QD_KYC_REPORT ADD (
  ai_risk_suggestion      VARCHAR2(10),     -- LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH
  ai_risk_rationale       VARCHAR2(2000),
  ai_risk_accepted_flag   CHAR(1),          -- Y = accepted, N = overridden
  ai_risk_override_reason VARCHAR2(500),
  ai_conclusion_draft     CLOB,
  ai_conclusion_gen_date  DATE
);

COMMENT ON COLUMN QD_KYC_REPORT.ai_risk_suggestion      IS 'AI-suggested risk level prior to officer decision';
COMMENT ON COLUMN QD_KYC_REPORT.ai_risk_rationale       IS 'Plain-text rationale returned by AI model';
COMMENT ON COLUMN QD_KYC_REPORT.ai_risk_accepted_flag   IS 'Y if officer accepted suggestion; N if overridden';
COMMENT ON COLUMN QD_KYC_REPORT.ai_risk_override_reason IS 'Mandatory reason text when officer overrides AI suggestion';
COMMENT ON COLUMN QD_KYC_REPORT.ai_conclusion_draft     IS 'AI-generated conclusion draft — immutable after first save';
COMMENT ON COLUMN QD_KYC_REPORT.ai_conclusion_gen_date  IS 'Date draft was first generated';

docs.title: 3.3 QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS — Document AI Classification Columns
docs.text:
ALTER TABLE QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS ADD (
  ai_doc_type           VARCHAR2(100),
  ai_confidence_score   NUMBER(5,4),
  ai_doc_corrected_flag CHAR(1),        -- Y if officer corrected the AI classification
  ai_doc_corrected_type VARCHAR2(100)   -- Officer's corrected document type
);

COMMENT ON COLUMN QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS.ai_doc_type           IS 'Document type label returned by OCI AI Document Understanding';
COMMENT ON COLUMN QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS.ai_confidence_score   IS 'Confidence score 0.0000 to 1.0000';
COMMENT ON COLUMN QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS.ai_doc_corrected_flag IS 'Y if officer manually corrected AI classification';
COMMENT ON COLUMN QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS.ai_doc_corrected_type IS 'Officer-supplied document type when AI classification was incorrect';

docs.title: 3.4 QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT — New Immutable Audit Table
docs.text:
CREATE TABLE QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT (
  audit_id        NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  report_id       NUMBER,
  document_id     NUMBER,
  entity_id       NUMBER,
  ai_feature      VARCHAR2(50),   -- RISK_SCORING / CONCLUSION_DRAFT / DOC_CLASSIFY / VECTOR_SEARCH / SELECT_AI
  model_id        VARCHAR2(200),
  prompt_hash     VARCHAR2(64),   -- SHA-256 hex of prompt sent to model
  ai_response     CLOB,
  accepted_flag   CHAR(1),        -- Y / N / NULL (not applicable for search features)
  override_reason VARCHAR2(500),
  action_user_id  NUMBER,
  action_date     TIMESTAMP DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT fk_ai_audit_report FOREIGN KEY (report_id)   REFERENCES QD_KYC_REPORT(report_id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_ai_audit_doc    FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS(document_id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_ai_audit_entity FOREIGN KEY (entity_id)   REFERENCES QD_KYC_ENTITY(entity_id),
  CONSTRAINT chk_ai_feature CHECK (ai_feature IN (
    'RISK_SCORING','CONCLUSION_DRAFT','DOC_CLASSIFY','VECTOR_SEARCH','SELECT_AI'
  ))
);

COMMENT ON TABLE  QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT IS 'Immutable audit log of all AI interactions. No UPDATE or DELETE permitted.';

Immutability trigger — same pattern as QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG:

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_ai_audit_immutable
  BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT
  FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
    'QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT is immutable. UPDATE and DELETE are not permitted.');
END trg_ai_audit_immutable;
/

docs.title: 4. AI Vector Search for Duplicate Entity Detection
4.1 Package Specification
docs.text:
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE QD_KYC_VECTOR_SEARCH AS

  -- Generate or refresh name embedding for a single entity
  PROCEDURE GENERATE_EMBEDDING (p_entity_id IN NUMBER);

  -- Return top-N most similar entities by cosine distance
  FUNCTION FIND_SIMILAR_ENTITIES (
    p_name  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_top_n IN NUMBER DEFAULT 10
  ) RETURN SYS_REFCURSOR;

END QD_KYC_VECTOR_SEARCH;
/

docs.title: 4.2 Package Body
docs.text:
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY QD_KYC_VECTOR_SEARCH AS

  C_EMBED_URL  CONSTANT VARCHAR2(500) :=
    'https://inference.generativeai.us-chicago-1.oci.oraclecloud.com'
    || '/20231130/actions/embedText';
  C_EMBED_MODEL CONSTANT VARCHAR2(200) := 'cohere.embed-multilingual-v3.0';

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PROCEDURE GENERATE_EMBEDDING (p_entity_id IN NUMBER) IS
    l_entity_name  QD_KYC_ENTITY.entity_name%TYPE;
    l_req_body     CLOB;
    l_response     CLOB;
    l_embedding    VECTOR(1536, FLOAT32);
  BEGIN
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(entity_name))
    INTO   l_entity_name
    FROM   QD_KYC_ENTITY
    WHERE  entity_id = p_entity_id;

    -- Build OCI Gen AI embedText request body
    APEX_JSON.INITIALIZE_CLOB_OUTPUT;
    APEX_JSON.OPEN_OBJECT;
    APEX_JSON.WRITE('inputs',     APEX_JSON.EMPTY_ARRAY); -- overwritten below
    APEX_JSON.CLOSE_OBJECT;
    -- Build manually for array input
    l_req_body := '{"inputs":["' || REPLACE(l_entity_name, '"', '\"')
                  || '"],"model":"' || C_EMBED_MODEL || '","inputType":"SEARCH_DOCUMENT"}';

    l_response := APEX_WEB_SERVICE.MAKE_REST_REQUEST(
      p_url         => C_EMBED_URL,
      p_http_method => 'POST',
      p_body        => l_req_body,
      p_credential_static_id => 'OCI_GENAI_CRED',
      p_http_headers => APEX_WEB_SERVICE.NEW_HEADERS(
        APEX_WEB_SERVICE.NEW_HEADER('Content-Type','application/json')
      )
    );

    -- Parse first embedding array from response: {"embeddings":[[0.1,0.2,...]]}
    APEX_JSON.PARSE(l_response);
    -- Convert JSON array to VECTOR — DB 23ai native function
    l_embedding := TO_VECTOR(
      APEX_JSON.GET_VARCHAR2(p_path => 'embeddings[1]'),
      1536, FLOAT32
    );

    UPDATE QD_KYC_ENTITY
    SET    name_embedding = l_embedding,
           embedding_date = SYSDATE
    WHERE  entity_id = p_entity_id;

    COMMIT;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
      ROLLBACK;
      RAISE;
  END GENERATE_EMBEDDING;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FUNCTION FIND_SIMILAR_ENTITIES (
    p_name  IN VARCHAR2,
    p_top_n IN NUMBER DEFAULT 10
  ) RETURN SYS_REFCURSOR IS
    l_req_body      CLOB;
    l_response      CLOB;
    l_query_vector  VECTOR(1536, FLOAT32);
    l_cursor        SYS_REFCURSOR;
  BEGIN
    -- Generate embedding for the query name on the fly
    l_req_body := '{"inputs":["' || REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(p_name)), '"', '\"')
                  || '"],"model":"' || C_EMBED_MODEL || '","inputType":"SEARCH_QUERY"}';

    l_response := APEX_WEB_SERVICE.MAKE_REST_REQUEST(
      p_url         => C_EMBED_URL,
      p_http_method => 'POST',
      p_body        => l_req_body,
      p_credential_static_id => 'OCI_GENAI_CRED',
      p_http_headers => APEX_WEB_SERVICE.NEW_HEADERS(
        APEX_WEB_SERVICE.NEW_HEADER('Content-Type','application/json')
      )
    );

    APEX_JSON.PARSE(l_response);
    l_query_vector := TO_VECTOR(
      APEX_JSON.GET_VARCHAR2(p_path => 'embeddings[1]'),
      1536, FLOAT32
    );

    OPEN l_cursor FOR
      SELECT e.entity_id,
             e.entity_name,
             e.entity_ref,
             ROUND(VECTOR_DISTANCE(e.name_embedding, l_query_vector, COSINE), 6) AS distance
      FROM   QD_KYC_ENTITY e
      WHERE  e.name_embedding IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY VECTOR_DISTANCE(e.name_embedding, l_query_vector, COSINE)
      FETCH FIRST p_top_n ROWS ONLY;

    RETURN l_cursor;
  END FIND_SIMILAR_ENTITIES;

END QD_KYC_VECTOR_SEARCH;
/

docs.title: 4.3 APEX Ajax Callback — Duplicate Check
docs.text:
Create an APEX Ajax Callback process named VECTOR_SIMILAR_ENTITIES on the entity edit page:

DECLARE
  l_cursor   SYS_REFCURSOR;
  l_id       NUMBER;
  l_name     VARCHAR2(500);
  l_ref      VARCHAR2(100);
  l_distance NUMBER;
BEGIN
  l_cursor := QD_KYC_VECTOR_SEARCH.FIND_SIMILAR_ENTITIES(
    p_name  => APEX_APPLICATION.G_X01,
    p_top_n => 10
  );

  APEX_JSON.OPEN_OBJECT;
  APEX_JSON.OPEN_ARRAY('results');
  LOOP
    FETCH l_cursor INTO l_id, l_name, l_ref, l_distance;
    EXIT WHEN l_cursor%NOTFOUND;
    APEX_JSON.OPEN_OBJECT;
    APEX_JSON.WRITE('entity_id', l_id);
    APEX_JSON.WRITE('entity_name', l_name);
    APEX_JSON.WRITE('entity_ref', l_ref);
    APEX_JSON.WRITE('distance', l_distance);
    APEX_JSON.CLOSE_OBJECT;
  END LOOP;
  CLOSE l_cursor;
  APEX_JSON.CLOSE_ARRAY;
  APEX_JSON.CLOSE_OBJECT;
END;

Wire a Dynamic Action on the entity name field (Event: Change, debounce 600 ms) to call this Ajax Callback and render results in a sub-region below the field. Similarity distance below 0.15 should be highlighted as a potential duplicate.

docs.title: 4.4 Nightly Embedding Refresh Job
docs.text:
BEGIN
  DBMS_SCHEDULER.CREATE_JOB(
    job_name        => 'QD_KYC_REFRESH_EMBEDDINGS',
    job_type        => 'PLSQL_BLOCK',
    job_action      => q'[
      BEGIN
        FOR r IN (
          SELECT entity_id
          FROM   QD_KYC_ENTITY
          WHERE  (name_embedding IS NULL
                  OR embedding_date < SYSDATE - 1)
          AND    last_update_date >= SYSDATE - 1
        ) LOOP
          QD_KYC_VECTOR_SEARCH.GENERATE_EMBEDDING(r.entity_id);
        END LOOP;
      END;
    ]',
    start_date      => SYSTIMESTAMP,
    repeat_interval => 'FREQ=DAILY;BYHOUR=2;BYMINUTE=0',
    enabled         => TRUE,
    comments        => 'Refresh name embeddings for entities modified in last 24 hours'
  );
END;
/

docs.title: 5.1 Approved Views
docs.text:
Select AI is restricted to three read-only views that expose no sensitive PII columns directly:

-- Reports search view — no individual PII fields
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW QD_KYC_V_REPORT_SEARCH AS
SELECT r.report_id,
       r.report_ref,
       r.report_status,
       r.risk_level,
       r.ai_risk_suggestion,
       r.created_date,
       r.submitted_date,
       r.assigned_officer_id,
       e.entity_ref,
       e.entity_type
FROM   QD_KYC_REPORT   r
JOIN   QD_KYC_ENTITY   e ON e.entity_id = r.entity_id;

-- Entity search view — name visible for search, no DOB / national ID
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW QD_KYC_V_ENTITY_SEARCH AS
SELECT entity_id,
       entity_ref,
       entity_name,
       entity_type,
       country_of_incorporation,
       fatf_tier,
       pep_flag,
       screening_status,
       created_date
FROM   QD_KYC_ENTITY;

-- Intake search view
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW QD_KYC_V_INTAKE_SEARCH AS
SELECT intake_id,
       intake_ref,
       intake_status,
       intake_date,
       entity_ref,
       assigned_officer_id
FROM   QD_KYC_INTAKE;

docs.title: 5.2 Create Select AI Profile
docs.text:
BEGIN
  DBMS_CLOUD_AI.CREATE_PROFILE(
    profile_name => 'KYC_SELECT_AI',
    attributes   => '{
      "provider": "oci",
      "credential_name": "OCI_GENAI_CRED",
      "object_list": [
        {"owner": "QD_KYC", "name": "QD_KYC_V_REPORT_SEARCH"},

        {"owner": "QD_KYC", "name": "QD_KYC_V_INTAKE_SEARCH"}

Grant the Select AI profile role SELECT on approved views only:

CREATE ROLE QD_KYC_SELECT_AI_ROLE;
GRANT SELECT ON QD_KYC_V_REPORT_SEARCH  TO QD_KYC_SELECT_AI_ROLE;
GRANT SELECT ON QD_KYC_V_ENTITY_SEARCH  TO QD_KYC_SELECT_AI_ROLE;
GRANT SELECT ON QD_KYC_V_INTAKE_SEARCH  TO QD_KYC_SELECT_AI_ROLE;

Do not grant SELECT on any base table to this role. The profile user context operates with minimum privilege.

docs.title: 5.3 APEX Page Implementation
docs.text:
On the KYC Search page, add:

  • Text Field P30_NL_QUERY — placeholder "Ask a question about KYC reports..."
  • Button SEARCH_NL — label "Ask"
  • Static Content Region to display the result

Ajax Callback process SELECT_AI_QUERY:

DECLARE
  l_sql    CLOB;
  l_result CLOB;
BEGIN
  -- Set Select AI profile for this session
  DBMS_CLOUD_AI.SET_PROFILE('KYC_SELECT_AI');

  -- Use NARRATE action to return a natural language answer
  EXECUTE IMMEDIATE
    'SELECT AI NARRATE ' || DBMS_ASSERT.NOOP(APEX_APPLICATION.G_X01)
  INTO l_result;

  -- Log to AI audit (query hash only — no data returned is stored)
  INSERT INTO QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT (
    ai_feature, model_id, prompt_hash, ai_response, action_user_id
  ) VALUES (
    'SELECT_AI',
    'KYC_SELECT_AI',
    LOWER(RAWTOHEX(DBMS_CRYPTO.HASH(
      UTL_I18N.STRING_TO_RAW(APEX_APPLICATION.G_X01, 'AL32UTF8'),
      DBMS_CRYPTO.HASH_SH256
    ))),
    'NARRATE query executed — data not stored in audit',
    APEX_CUSTOM_AUTH.GET_USER_ID
  );
  COMMIT;

  APEX_JSON.OPEN_OBJECT;
  APEX_JSON.WRITE('result', l_result);
  APEX_JSON.CLOSE_OBJECT;
END;

Security note: validate APEX_APPLICATION.G_X01 length (max 500 chars) and reject if it contains SQL injection patterns before passing to SELECT AI NARRATE.

docs.title: 6.1 Document Type Mapping
docs.text:
OCI Label KYC Document Type BANK_STATEMENT Bank Statement PASSPORT Passport DRIVING_LICENSE Driving Licence CHEQUE Cheque INVOICE Invoice RECEIPT Receipt RESUME (flag as unexpected — no KYC match) TAX_FORM Tax Document

KYC-specific labels not in the OCI taxonomy (e.g. Commercial Registration, Ownership Declaration) will return low confidence; the officer classification correction workflow handles these.

docs.title: 6.2 Package QD_KYC_DOC_AI
docs.text:
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE QD_KYC_DOC_AI AS

  PROCEDURE CLASSIFY_DOCUMENT (p_document_id IN NUMBER);

END QD_KYC_DOC_AI;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY QD_KYC_DOC_AI AS

  C_DOC_AI_URL CONSTANT VARCHAR2(500) :=
    'https://document.aiservice.us-chicago-1.oci.oraclecloud.com'
    || '/20221109/actions/analyzeDocument';

  PROCEDURE CLASSIFY_DOCUMENT (p_document_id IN NUMBER) IS
    l_doc_content   BLOB;
    l_doc_b64       CLOB;
    l_req_body      CLOB;
    l_response      CLOB;
    l_doc_type      VARCHAR2(100);
    l_confidence    NUMBER;
    l_kyc_doc_type  VARCHAR2(100);
    l_bucket        VARCHAR2(200);
    l_object_name   VARCHAR2(500);
  BEGIN
    -- V5/V6: documents are in OCI Object Storage — no BLOB column in QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS
    SELECT bucket_name, object_name
    INTO   l_bucket, l_object_name
    FROM   QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS
    WHERE  document_id = p_document_id;

    -- Retrieve document content from OCI Object Storage
    l_doc_content := DBMS_CLOUD.GET_OBJECT(
      credential_name => 'OCI_NATIVE_CRED',
      object_uri      => 'https://objectstorage.' || :OCI_REGION
                         || '.oraclecloud.com/n/' || :OCI_NAMESPACE
                         || '/b/' || l_bucket
                         || '/o/' || UTL_URL.ESCAPE(l_object_name)
    );

    -- Base64-encode for inline submission
    l_doc_b64 := UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_VARCHAR2(
      UTL_ENCODE.BASE64_ENCODE(l_doc_content)
    );

    -- Build OCI Document Understanding request
    l_req_body :=
      '{'
      || '"processorConfig":{"processorType":"GENERAL","features":[{"featureType":"DOCUMENT_CLASSIFICATION"}]},'
      || '"document":{"source":"INLINE","data":"' || l_doc_b64 || '"}'
      || '}';

    l_response := APEX_WEB_SERVICE.MAKE_REST_REQUEST(
      p_url         => C_DOC_AI_URL,
      p_http_method => 'POST',
      p_body        => l_req_body,
      p_credential_static_id => 'OCI_GENAI_CRED',
      p_http_headers => APEX_WEB_SERVICE.NEW_HEADERS(
        APEX_WEB_SERVICE.NEW_HEADER('Content-Type','application/json')
      )
    );

    APEX_JSON.PARSE(l_response);
    l_doc_type   := APEX_JSON.GET_VARCHAR2(p_path => 'pages[1].documentClassification.documentType');
    l_confidence := APEX_JSON.GET_NUMBER(p_path  => 'pages[1].documentClassification.confidence');

    -- Map OCI label to KYC doc type
    l_kyc_doc_type := CASE l_doc_type
      WHEN 'PASSPORT'         THEN 'Passport'
      WHEN 'DRIVING_LICENSE'  THEN 'Driving Licence'
      WHEN 'BANK_STATEMENT'   THEN 'Bank Statement'
      WHEN 'TAX_FORM'         THEN 'Tax Document'
      WHEN 'INVOICE'          THEN 'Invoice'
      WHEN 'RECEIPT'          THEN 'Receipt'
      WHEN 'CHEQUE'           THEN 'Cheque'
      ELSE 'Unknown — Officer Review Required'
    END;

    -- Store classification result
    UPDATE QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS
    SET    ai_doc_type         = l_kyc_doc_type,
           ai_confidence_score = l_confidence,
           ai_doc_corrected_flag = 'N'
    WHERE  document_id = p_document_id;

    -- Audit
    INSERT INTO QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT (
      document_id, ai_feature, model_id, prompt_hash,
      ai_response, action_user_id
    ) VALUES (
      p_document_id,
      'DOC_CLASSIFY',
      'OCI_AI_DOCUMENT_UNDERSTANDING',
      LOWER(RAWTOHEX(DBMS_CRYPTO.HASH(
        UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW(TO_CHAR(p_document_id)),
        DBMS_CRYPTO.HASH_SH256
      ))),
      l_response,
      APEX_CUSTOM_AUTH.GET_USER_ID
    );
    COMMIT;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
      ROLLBACK;
      RAISE;
  END CLASSIFY_DOCUMENT;

END QD_KYC_DOC_AI;
/

docs.title: 6.3 APEX Dynamic Action — Post Upload Classification
docs.text:
On the Document Upload page:

  1. Event: After Successful Upload (File Browse item P20_DOC_FILE)
  2. True Action 1: Execute Server-Side Code
BEGIN
  QD_KYC_DOC_AI.CLASSIFY_DOCUMENT(p_document_id => :P20_DOCUMENT_ID);
END;
  1. True Action 2: Refresh region Documents_List to display classification badges.

Display badge logic in the Documents interactive grid: show confidence as a coloured badge (green >= 0.80, amber 0.50–0.79, red < 0.50). When red or Unknown, the officer's ai_doc_corrected_type field becomes mandatory before the document can be marked as verified.

docs.title: 7.1 Package QD_KYC_AI_RISK
docs.text:
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE QD_KYC_AI_RISK AS

  PROCEDURE SUGGEST_RISK_LEVEL (p_report_id IN NUMBER);
  PROCEDURE ACCEPT_SUGGESTION  (p_report_id IN NUMBER, p_user_id IN NUMBER);
  PROCEDURE OVERRIDE_SUGGESTION(
    p_report_id     IN NUMBER,
    p_user_id       IN NUMBER,
    p_override_reason IN VARCHAR2
  );

END QD_KYC_AI_RISK;
/

docs.title: 7.2 Package Body
docs.text:
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY QD_KYC_AI_RISK AS

  C_CHAT_URL   CONSTANT VARCHAR2(500) :=
    'https://inference.generativeai.us-chicago-1.oci.oraclecloud.com'
    || '/20231130/actions/chat';
  C_CHAT_MODEL CONSTANT VARCHAR2(200) := 'meta.llama-3.1-70b-instruct';

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PROCEDURE SUGGEST_RISK_LEVEL (p_report_id IN NUMBER) IS
    l_entity_name   VARCHAR2(500);
    l_country       VARCHAR2(100);
    l_fatf_tier     VARCHAR2(20);
    l_pep_flag      CHAR(1);
    l_ownership_layers NUMBER;
    l_screening_match  VARCHAR2(20);
    l_prompt        CLOB;
    l_req_body      CLOB;
    l_response      CLOB;
    l_risk_level    VARCHAR2(10);
    l_rationale     VARCHAR2(2000);
    l_prompt_hash   VARCHAR2(64);
  BEGIN
    -- Gather report context
    SELECT e.entity_name,
           e.country_of_incorporation,
           e.fatf_tier,
           e.pep_flag,
           e.ownership_layers,
           e.screening_status
    INTO   l_entity_name, l_country, l_fatf_tier,
           l_pep_flag, l_ownership_layers, l_screening_match
    FROM   QD_KYC_REPORT r
    JOIN   QD_KYC_ENTITY e ON e.entity_id = r.entity_id
    WHERE  r.report_id = p_report_id;

    -- Build structured prompt
    l_prompt :=
      'You are a KYC compliance analyst for Qatari Diar, a Qatari sovereign wealth real estate company. '
      || 'Assess the following entity and return ONLY valid JSON in this exact format: '
      || '{"risk_level":"LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH","rationale":"<max 300 words>"}' || CHR(10)
      || CHR(10)
      || 'Entity: ' || l_entity_name || CHR(10)
      || 'Country of Incorporation: ' || l_country || CHR(10)
      || 'FATF Tier: ' || l_fatf_tier || CHR(10)
      || 'PEP Status: ' || CASE l_pep_flag WHEN 'Y' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END || CHR(10)
      || 'Ownership Layers: ' || TO_CHAR(l_ownership_layers) || CHR(10)
      || 'Screening Match Status: ' || l_screening_match || CHR(10)
      || CHR(10)
      || 'Apply FATF recommendations, Qatari AML Law No. 4 of 2010, and standard CDD thresholds. '
      || 'Do not include any text outside the JSON object.';

    -- Hash prompt for audit
    l_prompt_hash := LOWER(RAWTOHEX(DBMS_CRYPTO.HASH(
      UTL_I18N.STRING_TO_RAW(l_prompt, 'AL32UTF8'),
      DBMS_CRYPTO.HASH_SH256
    )));

    -- Build OCI Gen AI chat request
    l_req_body :=
      '{"model":"' || C_CHAT_MODEL || '",'
      || '"chatRequest":{"messages":[{"role":"USER","content":[{"type":"TEXT","text":'
      || APEX_JSON.STRINGIFY(l_prompt)
      || '}]}],"maxTokens":500,"temperature":0.1,"isStream":false}}';

    l_response := APEX_WEB_SERVICE.MAKE_REST_REQUEST(
      p_url         => C_CHAT_URL,
      p_http_method => 'POST',
      p_body        => l_req_body,
      p_credential_static_id => 'OCI_GENAI_CRED',
      p_http_headers => APEX_WEB_SERVICE.NEW_HEADERS(
        APEX_WEB_SERVICE.NEW_HEADER('Content-Type','application/json')
      )
    );

    -- Parse JSON response: {"chatResponse":{"text":"{\"risk_level\":\"HIGH\",...}"}}
    APEX_JSON.PARSE(l_response);
    DECLARE
      l_inner CLOB;
    BEGIN
      l_inner := APEX_JSON.GET_CLOB_OUTPUT;  -- fallback
      l_inner := APEX_JSON.GET_VARCHAR2(p_path => 'chatResponse.text');
      APEX_JSON.PARSE(l_inner);
      l_risk_level := APEX_JSON.GET_VARCHAR2(p_path => 'risk_level');
      l_rationale  := APEX_JSON.GET_VARCHAR2(p_path => 'rationale');
    END;

    -- Validate
    IF l_risk_level NOT IN ('LOW','MEDIUM','HIGH') THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20010, 'AI returned invalid risk level: ' || l_risk_level);
    END IF;

    UPDATE QD_KYC_REPORT
    SET    ai_risk_suggestion = l_risk_level,
           ai_risk_rationale  = l_rationale
    WHERE  report_id = p_report_id;

    INSERT INTO QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT (
      report_id, ai_feature, model_id, prompt_hash, ai_response, action_user_id
    ) VALUES (
      p_report_id, 'RISK_SCORING', C_CHAT_MODEL, l_prompt_hash, l_response,
      APEX_CUSTOM_AUTH.GET_USER_ID
    );
    COMMIT;
  END SUGGEST_RISK_LEVEL;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PROCEDURE ACCEPT_SUGGESTION (p_report_id IN NUMBER, p_user_id IN NUMBER) IS
  BEGIN
    UPDATE QD_KYC_REPORT
    SET    ai_risk_accepted_flag = 'Y',
           risk_level            = ai_risk_suggestion
    WHERE  report_id = p_report_id;

    -- QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT is immutable (INSERT-only). Record acceptance as a new audit row.
    INSERT INTO QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT (
      report_id, ai_feature, model_id, prompt_hash,
      ai_response, accepted_flag, action_user_id
    )
    SELECT report_id, 'RISK_SCORING_ACCEPT', model_id, prompt_hash,
           'Officer accepted AI suggestion: ' || ai_risk_suggestion,
           'Y', p_user_id
    FROM   QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT
    WHERE  report_id  = p_report_id
    AND    ai_feature = 'RISK_SCORING'
    AND    audit_id   = (SELECT MAX(audit_id) FROM QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT
                         WHERE report_id = p_report_id AND ai_feature = 'RISK_SCORING');
    COMMIT;
  END ACCEPT_SUGGESTION;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PROCEDURE OVERRIDE_SUGGESTION (
    p_report_id       IN NUMBER,
    p_user_id         IN NUMBER,
    p_override_reason IN VARCHAR2
  ) IS
  BEGIN
    IF p_override_reason IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(p_override_reason)) < 10 THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20011,
        'Override reason is mandatory and must be at least 10 characters.');
    END IF;

    UPDATE QD_KYC_REPORT
    SET    ai_risk_accepted_flag   = 'N',
           ai_risk_override_reason = p_override_reason
    WHERE  report_id = p_report_id;

    -- QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT is immutable (INSERT-only). Record override as a new audit row.
    INSERT INTO QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT (
      report_id, ai_feature, model_id, prompt_hash,
      ai_response, accepted_flag, override_reason, action_user_id
    )
    SELECT report_id, 'RISK_SCORING_OVERRIDE', model_id, prompt_hash,
           'Officer overrode AI suggestion. Original: ' || ai_risk_suggestion,
           'N', p_override_reason, p_user_id
    FROM   QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT
    WHERE  report_id  = p_report_id
    AND    ai_feature = 'RISK_SCORING'
    AND    audit_id   = (SELECT MAX(audit_id) FROM QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT
                         WHERE report_id = p_report_id AND ai_feature = 'RISK_SCORING');
    COMMIT;
  END OVERRIDE_SUGGESTION;

END QD_KYC_AI_RISK;
/

docs.title: 7.3 APEX Page Wiring
docs.text:
On the Report Review page:

  • Button SUGGEST_RISK (label: "Get AI Risk Suggestion") — calls process AI_SUGGEST_RISK, then refreshes the risk region.
  • Display Only field P25_AI_RISK_SUGGESTION bound to ai_risk_suggestion.
  • Text Area P25_AI_RISK_RATIONALE (read only) bound to ai_risk_rationale.
  • Button ACCEPT_RISK — visible only when ai_risk_suggestion IS NOT NULL AND ai_risk_accepted_flag IS NULL. Calls QD_KYC_AI_RISK.ACCEPT_SUGGESTION.
  • Button OVERRIDE_RISK — opens inline dialog with mandatory textarea for override reason. Calls QD_KYC_AI_RISK.OVERRIDE_SUGGESTION.

docs.title: 8.1 Package QD_KYC_AI_CONCLUSION
docs.text:
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE QD_KYC_AI_CONCLUSION AS

  PROCEDURE GENERATE_DRAFT (p_report_id IN NUMBER);

END QD_KYC_AI_CONCLUSION;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY QD_KYC_AI_CONCLUSION AS

  C_CHAT_URL   CONSTANT VARCHAR2(500) :=
    'https://inference.generativeai.us-chicago-1.oci.oraclecloud.com'
    || '/20231130/actions/chat';
  C_CHAT_MODEL CONSTANT VARCHAR2(200) := 'meta.llama-3.1-70b-instruct';

  PROCEDURE GENERATE_DRAFT (p_report_id IN NUMBER) IS
    l_entity_name   VARCHAR2(500);
    l_country       VARCHAR2(100);
    l_fatf_tier     VARCHAR2(20);
    l_pep_flag      CHAR(1);
    l_risk_level    VARCHAR2(10);
    l_screening     VARCHAR2(20);
    l_doc_count     NUMBER;
    l_existing_draft CLOB;
    l_prompt        CLOB;
    l_req_body      CLOB;
    l_response      CLOB;
    l_draft_text    CLOB;
    l_prompt_hash   VARCHAR2(64);
  BEGIN
    -- Immutability guard — draft cannot be regenerated once saved
    SELECT ai_conclusion_draft
    INTO   l_existing_draft
    FROM   QD_KYC_REPORT
    WHERE  report_id = p_report_id;

    IF l_existing_draft IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20012,
        'AI conclusion draft already exists for this report and cannot be regenerated.');
    END IF;

    -- Gather context
    SELECT e.entity_name, e.country_of_incorporation, e.fatf_tier,
           e.pep_flag, r.risk_level, e.screening_status,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS d WHERE d.report_id = r.report_id)
    INTO   l_entity_name, l_country, l_fatf_tier,
           l_pep_flag, l_risk_level, l_screening, l_doc_count
    FROM   QD_KYC_REPORT r
    JOIN   QD_KYC_ENTITY e ON e.entity_id = r.entity_id
    WHERE  r.report_id = p_report_id;

    l_prompt :=
      'You are a KYC compliance officer at Qatari Diar. '
      || 'Write a formal KYC conclusion paragraph (200-300 words) for the following entity review. '
      || 'Use professional regulatory language. Do not include section headings or bullet points — '
      || 'produce a single flowing paragraph suitable for a compliance report.' || CHR(10)
      || CHR(10)
      || 'Entity Name: '           || l_entity_name  || CHR(10)
      || 'Country: '               || l_country      || CHR(10)
      || 'FATF Tier: '             || l_fatf_tier     || CHR(10)
      || 'PEP: '                   || CASE l_pep_flag WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END || CHR(10)
      || 'Risk Level Assigned: '   || l_risk_level    || CHR(10)
      || 'Screening Outcome: '     || l_screening     || CHR(10)
      || 'Documents Reviewed: '    || TO_CHAR(l_doc_count) || CHR(10);

    l_prompt_hash := LOWER(RAWTOHEX(DBMS_CRYPTO.HASH(
      UTL_I18N.STRING_TO_RAW(l_prompt, 'AL32UTF8'),
      DBMS_CRYPTO.HASH_SH256
    )));

    l_req_body :=
      '{"model":"' || C_CHAT_MODEL || '",'
      || '"chatRequest":{"messages":[{"role":"USER","content":[{"type":"TEXT","text":'
      || APEX_JSON.STRINGIFY(l_prompt)
      || '}]}],"maxTokens":700,"temperature":0.3,"isStream":false}}';

    l_response := APEX_WEB_SERVICE.MAKE_REST_REQUEST(
      p_url         => C_CHAT_URL,
      p_http_method => 'POST',
      p_body        => l_req_body,
      p_credential_static_id => 'OCI_GENAI_CRED',
      p_http_headers => APEX_WEB_SERVICE.NEW_HEADERS(
        APEX_WEB_SERVICE.NEW_HEADER('Content-Type','application/json')
      )
    );

    APEX_JSON.PARSE(l_response);
    l_draft_text := APEX_JSON.GET_VARCHAR2(p_path => 'chatResponse.text');

    -- Save draft — immutable from this point
    UPDATE QD_KYC_REPORT
    SET    ai_conclusion_draft    = l_draft_text,
           ai_conclusion_gen_date = SYSDATE
    WHERE  report_id = p_report_id;

    INSERT INTO QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT (
      report_id, ai_feature, model_id, prompt_hash, ai_response, action_user_id
    ) VALUES (
      p_report_id, 'CONCLUSION_DRAFT', C_CHAT_MODEL, l_prompt_hash, l_response,
      APEX_CUSTOM_AUTH.GET_USER_ID
    );
    COMMIT;
  END GENERATE_DRAFT;

END QD_KYC_AI_CONCLUSION;
/

docs.title: 8.2 APEX Page Implementation
docs.text:
On the Report Conclusion page:

  • Button GENERATE_DRAFT (label: "Generate AI Draft") — visible only when ai_conclusion_draft IS NULL. After click, calls server-side process invoking QD_KYC_AI_CONCLUSION.GENERATE_DRAFT, then refreshes the page.
  • Text Area P30_CONCLUSION — editable. Initially populated from ai_conclusion_draft. Officer edits this field before final submission.
  • ai_conclusion_draft column is never modified after first save. The officer's final text is stored in a separate conclusion_text column on QD_KYC_REPORT.
  • The Generate Draft button is conditionally hidden once ai_conclusion_draft IS NOT NULL, enforcing single-generation.

docs.title: 9. APEX AI Assistant Configuration
docs.text:
APEX 26 introduces a built-in AI Assistant configurable at workspace level. Configure in APEX Administration → Workspace Settings → AI Assistant.

Setting Value Enable AI Assistant Yes AI Provider OCI Generative AI OCI Credential OCI_GENAI_CRED Model meta.llama-3.1-70b-instruct or cohere.command-r-plus System Prompt See below Allowed Schema Objects QD_KYC_REF_* tables and QD_KYC_REF_COUNTRY only Blocked Objects All QD_KYC_REPORT, QD_KYC_ENTITY, QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS, QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT

System prompt:

You are a KYC compliance assistant for Qatari Diar Real Estate Investment Company.
You help KYC officers understand compliance policies, FATF recommendations, Qatar AML regulations,
document requirements, and risk categorisation guidelines.
You MUST NOT retrieve, display, or reference any individual report data, entity data,
personal data, or document content from the database.
You MAY only answer general policy questions and reference publicly available regulatory guidance.
If asked for data about a specific entity, report, or individual, respond:
"I cannot provide data on specific cases. Please use the KYC Report screen to review that information."

Data access enforcement: in APEX 26 AI Assistant page settings, grant the assistant access only to the QD_KYC_REF_* reference tables. Do not grant it the KYC_SELECT_AI profile or any base table access. The assistant's data access runs under a dedicated low-privilege database role QD_KYC_AI_ASSIST_ROLE that has SELECT on reference tables only.

CREATE ROLE QD_KYC_AI_ASSIST_ROLE;
GRANT SELECT ON QD_KYC_REF_COUNTRY      TO QD_KYC_AI_ASSIST_ROLE;
GRANT SELECT ON QD_KYC_REF_DOC_TYPE     TO QD_KYC_AI_ASSIST_ROLE;
GRANT SELECT ON QD_KYC_REF_RISK_FACTOR  TO QD_KYC_AI_ASSIST_ROLE;

docs.title: 10. AI Audit Trail
docs.text:
The QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT table is the single record of all AI interactions. Every AI feature writes one row per invocation before committing. The immutability trigger prevents post-hoc modification.

Feature Trigger Fields Captured Vector Search Duplicate check run by officer or nightly job entity_id, query text hash (prompt_hash), top result distance scores in ai_response Doc Classification Document uploaded to system document_id, ai_doc_type, confidence score, full OCI response in ai_response Risk Scoring Officer clicks "Get AI Risk Suggestion" report_id, model_id, prompt_hash, suggested level, accepted_flag, override_reason Conclusion Draft Officer clicks "Generate AI Draft" report_id, model_id, prompt_hash, draft character length, full response in ai_response Select AI Officer submits natural language query action_user_id, query hash in prompt_hash, note in ai_response — raw query data is never stored

Downstream reports join QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT to QD_KYC_REPORT to produce per-report AI decision summaries for compliance review. The audit table is included in the ATP scheduled export to OCI Object Storage alongside QD_KYC_PROCESS_LOG.

Immutability trigger (restated for completeness):

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_ai_audit_immutable
  BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT
  FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
    'QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT is immutable. UPDATE and DELETE are not permitted.');
END trg_ai_audit_immutable;
/

docs.title: 11. APEX Workflow — V6 Changes
docs.text: The APEX Workflow definition in V6 is structurally identical to V5 (Section 7 of the V5 specification). No new workflow activities are added in V6.

docs.title: 11.1 SAR Outcome Handling
docs.text:
The SAR_REVIEW activity (Activity 8 in V5) operates as follows — unchanged from the corrected V5 definition:

SAR Outcome System Action SAR_DISMISSED Return to L2_APPROVAL — approval proceeds normally SAR_FILED Set report_status = 'SAR_PROCESS'; notify Head of Compliance and System Administrator; suspend workflow

A SAR flag pauses the KYC approval — the report is not rejected. The case remains open in SAR_PROCESS status while the SAR is handled through a separate process outside the KYC system. Once the SAR process concludes, the compliance administrator manually returns the case to L2 approval or closes it.

docs.title: 11.2 AI Task Type (Future)
docs.text: APEX 26 introduces an AI Task type in the Workflow Builder, allowing AI-generated outputs (risk scores, conclusion drafts) to be created as named workflow activities rather than invoked from page processes. This is available as a future enhancement; V6 invokes all AI packages from APEX page processes (see Sections 7 and 8). Migration to AI Task types does not require schema changes.

docs.title: 12. Acceptance Test Checklist
docs.text: The following tests are specific to V6 AI features. All V5 acceptance tests remain applicable.

docs.title: AI Vector Search
docs.text:
• [ ] Enter an entity name variation (abbreviation, Arabic transliteration) in the entity edit form — vector search returns the matching entity with distance < 0.20 within 3 seconds.
  • [ ] Enter an unrelated name — no results returned with distance < 0.30.
  • [ ] Run QD_KYC_REFRESH_EMBEDDINGS job manually — completes without error; embedding_date updated for entities modified in last 24 hours.
  • [ ] Verify QD_KYC_ENTITY.name_embedding is populated (not NULL) for all entities after full refresh run.

docs.title: Select AI
docs.text:
• [ ] Submit 5 test natural language queries and verify the returned SQL references only QD_KYC_V_REPORT_SEARCH, QD_KYC_V_ENTITY_SEARCH, or QD_KYC_V_INTAKE_SEARCH.
  • [ ] Confirm SQL generated does not reference QD_KYC_DOCUMENTS, QD_KYC_ENTITY base table, or QD_KYC_REPORT base table directly.
  • [ ] Each query execution inserts a row in QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT with ai_feature = 'SELECT_AI'.

docs.title: Document Classification
docs.text:
• [ ] Upload a Commercial Registration PDF — OCI returns label, confidence badge displays in document region.
  • [ ] Upload a Passport JPEG — OCI returns PASSPORT label with confidence >= 0.80; badge displays green.
  • [ ] Upload an Ownership Declaration — OCI returns unknown or low-confidence label (< 0.50); badge displays red; officer correction fields become mandatory.
  • [ ] Correct an AI classification — ai_doc_corrected_flag = 'Y' and ai_doc_corrected_type saved; audit row written.

docs.title: Risk Scoring
docs.text:
• [ ] On a report with entity data and screening status saved, click "Get AI Risk Suggestion" — ai_risk_suggestion populated within 10 seconds.
  • [ ] Click "Accept" — ai_risk_accepted_flag = 'Y', risk_level updated to match suggestion.
  • [ ] Click "Override" with no reason text — validation error raised; save blocked.
  • [ ] Click "Override" with valid reason (>= 10 chars) — ai_risk_accepted_flag = 'N', ai_risk_override_reason saved.
  • [ ] Audit row present with ai_feature = 'RISK_SCORING' for both accept and override paths.

docs.title: Conclusion Drafting
docs.text:
• [ ] Click "Generate AI Draft" on a report — ai_conclusion_draft populated; button hidden on page refresh.
  • [ ] Attempt to call QD_KYC_AI_CONCLUSION.GENERATE_DRAFT a second time on same report — ORA-20012 raised.
  • [ ] Officer edits the conclusion textarea and saves — conclusion_text updated; ai_conclusion_draft column unchanged.
  • [ ] Audit row present with ai_feature = 'CONCLUSION_DRAFT'.

docs.title: AI Audit Immutability
docs.text:
• [ ] Execute UPDATE QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT SET accepted_flag = 'Y' WHERE ROWNUM = 1 — ORA-20001 raised by trigger; no row updated.
  • [ ] Execute DELETE FROM QD_KYC_AI_AUDIT WHERE ROWNUM = 1 — ORA-20001 raised; no row deleted.

docs.title: APEX AI Assistant
docs.text:
• [ ] Ask the AI Assistant a general FATF policy question — coherent answer returned without referencing any specific entity or report data.
  • [ ] Ask the AI Assistant "Show me all HIGH risk reports" — assistant returns the standard refusal message without querying the database.
  • [ ] Confirm assistant session does not have access to QD_KYC_REPORT or QD_KYC_ENTITY by inspecting grants on QD_KYC_AI_ASSIST_ROLE.
